notToBeConfusedWith.name: Campari
notToBeConfusedWith.note: From the same owner and the same shelf, and not interchangeable: roughly twice the strength, considerably less sweet and far more bitter.

generalSubstitutes.note: Higher in strength and considerably more bitter and less sweet, so a drink built on it comes out shorter, drier and much more assertive. Closer to a different drink than to a substitution.

forms.label: Standard
forms.sourceNote: The producer's own consumer-information page states 11% alc./vol. and, per 1.5 fl oz serving, 74 calories and 11.6 g of carbohydrate; those are restated here per 100 ml (44.36 ml to the 1.5 fl oz). Carbohydrate is taken as sugar because the product carries no other kind. Cross-checked against the site's own energy arithmetic: 11% alcohol plus 26.2 g of sugar comes to about 165 kcal against the 167 restated here, a match close enough to be credible, unlike the Open Food Facts branded records for this product, which disagree with themselves and with each other on both strength (11%, 12.5% and 15% across listings) and calories, and are not used.
